content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fredericksburg

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific education and hours requirements—most candidates meet them through a bachelor's degree plus years of verifiable project work. Granite PM Academy can clarify whether your background qualifies before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Our instructor-led course meets PMI's required contact hours in a structured, interactive format. You'll learn across multiple sessions on your schedule, with real-time Q&A and peer collaboration—no self-paced recordings.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, submit your formal PMP application to PMI, documenting your education and project experience. Pay PMI's exam fee at application. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the submission process and helps ensure your experience documentation is complete and accurate.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to reinforce bootcamp content. Schedule your computerized exam through PMI's testing partner. Our team remains available to answer last-minute questions and help you approach test day with confidence.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, commit to earning professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle. PMI requires you to demonstrate ongoing learning through training, volunteering, or contributions to the profession. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible continuing-education courses to support your recertification.
